senses.gloss: --a tribe who were defeated by Sagara and deprived of their क्षत्रिय right of Vedic study and sacrifice; became Mlecchas and were allowed to have long hair. Vi. IV. 3. ४२, ४७-8.

--kinds of sins; निर्यासम् (drinking of the milk of trees) Kalamjam (taking opium), Kalingam, गृम्य्जनम् (eating garlic), छत्राकम् (eating of mushroom?), महा- कोशातकी, Mallika (dealing in jasmine), use of the nut of the tree कतकम्, and Umbaram (felling of fig trees), Kaya- kam? वार्ताकम् (eating brinjal), taking of pot-herbs, of बिम्बि fruits, of लम्बिक, misappropriation of public funds (पुरग्रामन्ग), misuse of the special वैश्य funds, resi- dence in a कुग्राम, profession of a physician, trafficing in women, living by arms, sale of oily foods, eating food from cowherds,
1: Br. IV. 8. ४१-49.
and eating without guest;
2: Ib. IV. 2. १६१; Vi. II. 6. 6-२९.
brahmicide and teach- ing of Vedas for money;
3: Br. III. १४. ४३; १५. ४८.
threefold, arising from speech, mind and body.
4: वा. १८. 2.
